app_info.subtitle: Access the Schulportal Hessen
app_info.description: Lanis lets users interact with Schulportal Hessen so they can view timetables, substitutions, calendars, messages, courses, files, and homework, and perform approved message and homework actions through ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the hosted LANIS API health status without changing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or send anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves aggregate API database and task-queue statistics.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or send anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Authenticates the user and establishes a private Schulportal session with new access credentials.
justifications.open_world_justification: The session change is confined to the user's private LANIS and Schulportal account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a session but does not delete data, revoke access, or send content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Exchanges a refresh credential for a new private access credential.
justifications.open_world_justification: The authentication change is confined to the user's private LANIS session.
justifications.destructive_justification: Refreshes authentication without deleting data, revoking access, or sending content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Invalidates the user's tokens and server-side Schulportal session.
justifications.open_world_justification: The logout affects only the user's private authentication state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Revokes the active session and credentials, requiring the user to authenticate again.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists Hessian school districts and schools.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or send anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists schools belonging to the selected Hessian district.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or send anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches the Hessian school directory by name or location.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or send anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the Schulportal apps available to the authenticated user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not launch apps, publish content, or change an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or send anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves enabled Schulportal modules and their launch metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not launch modules, publish content, or change an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or send anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the authenticated user's Schulportal profile.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish profile data or change an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or remove the user's profile.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the user's calendar overview, filters, and views.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not create, publish, or modify calendar events.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite calendar data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves calendar events matching the supplied filters.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not create, publish, or modify calendar events.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite calendar data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves details for one selected calendar event.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not create, publish, or modify calendar events.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite calendar data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the authenticated user's Schulportal substitution plan.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish or alter the school's substitution plan.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite schedule data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the authenticated user's timetable.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish or alter timetable data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite schedule data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists the contents of a selected private Schulportal storage folder.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not upload, share, or publish stored files.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, move, or overwrite files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches the authenticated user's private Schulportal file storage.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not upload, share, or publish stored files.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, move, or overwrite files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the user's private LernGruppen overview.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not create groups, contact members, or publish content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter or remove study-group data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves message and conversation headers from the selected mailbox.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send messages or change message state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or mark messages.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves messages from one private Schulportal conversation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not reply, forward, or publish conversation content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or mark messages.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches the private Schulportal recipient directory.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact recipients or publish directory data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or send anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sends a new message to the selected Schulportal recipients.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes an external school communication system by delivering content to other users.
justifications.destructive_justification: Message delivery is an irreversible external communication and the tool requires prior confirmation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Adds and sends a reply in an existing Schulportal conversation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes an external school communication system by delivering content to other users.
justifications.destructive_justification: Reply delivery is an irreversible external communication and the tool requires prior confirmation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes the selected private conversation's read state.
justifications.open_world_justification: The state change remains inside the user's private mailbox.
justifications.destructive_justification: Marks the conversation read without exposing a corresponding undo action and requires prior confirmation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the user's private Mein Unterricht course overview.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not create courses or publish course content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter or remove course data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves one course and its entries and file metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not create courses or publish course content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter or remove course data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the selected private course file and returns its content.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not upload, share, or publish the downloaded file.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, move, or overwrite files.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves detailed content for a selected course entry.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish or alter course content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter or remove course data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the user's private weekly Mein Unterricht view.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish or alter weekly course content.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter or remove course data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the authenticated user's private course submissions.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not submit, publish, or alter coursework.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite submissions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sets or clears the selected course entry's private homework-done state.
justifications.open_world_justification: The state change remains inside the user's private Schulportal account.
justifications.destructive_justification: The change is reversible by calling the tool with the opposite state and requires prior confirmation.

justifications.read_only_justification: Authenticates to DSBmobile and establishes private session state.
justifications.open_world_justification: The authentication change is confined to the user's private DSBmobile session.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a session without deleting data, revoking access, or sending content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Authenticates to DSBmobile before retrieving private substitution-plan URLs.
justifications.open_world_justification: The session and returned plan references remain within the user's private school workflow.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete data, revoke access, publish content, or send messages.

justifications.read_only_justification: May authenticate to DSBmobile before fetching and parsing a private substitution plan.
justifications.open_world_justification: The session and retrieved plan remain within the user's private school workflow.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete data, revoke access, publish content, or send messages.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches and returns matching content from the user's LANIS data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish search terms or results or change an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or send anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only computes and returns a sensitive SSO launch URL without opening it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not navigate to the URL, launch the app, or change an external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or send anything.

test_cases.description: Find the Schulportal school identifier for a Hessian school before login.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find the Schulportal Hessen school ID for Goetheschule in Kassel.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching Hessian schools with enough identifying information to select the correct school ID.
Returns the authenticated user's timetable in a concise, readable form.

test_cases.description: Filter the user's Schulportal calendar for a specific event topic.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search my Schulportal calendar for events containing Elternabend this year.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching calendar events and clearly states when no events match.

test_cases.description: List message headers from the authenticated user's inbox.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the first page of messages in my Schulportal inbox.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the inbox conversation headers without changing their read state.

test_cases.description: Send a Schulportal message only after the user explicitly confirms its contents and recipient identifier.
test_cases.user_prompt: I confirm: send a Schulportal message to recipient ID 12345 with subject 'Projektgruppe' and body 'Treffen wir uns morgen um 14 Uhr?'.
test_cases.expected_output: Sends the confirmed message once and reports whether delivery succeeded without exposing credentials.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for school-directory searches outside Hessen.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find every secondary school in Bavaria.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because its school directory covers Hessen rather than Bavaria.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unsupported account-recovery actions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Reset my Schulportal Hessen password for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot reset or recover Schulportal credentials.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general educational help unrelated to the user's Schulportal data.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Explain how photosynthesis works for my biology homework.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request does not require Schulportal data or actions.
